speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Histopathology findings show atypical melanocytes infiltrating the epidermis and dermis, confirming malignant melanoma. Regional lymph node ultrasound shows no abnormal lymphadenopathy. Patient confirms medical history of type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and glaucoma. Lesion does not bleed easily upon touch.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Superficial Spreading Melanoma of the chest.

The biopsy confirms atypical melanocytes, and despite the lack of regional lymphadenopathy, the histopathology is definitive for malignancy. We should proceed with staging workup, including an CT scan of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis to check for distant metastasis.
